sampleHeader: Analysis of sampling stage2-render-profile (pid 33129) every 1 millisecond

method.selfCount: node inclusive count minus sum of direct child inclusive counts
method.scope: Only the explicitly named com.apple.main-thread tree
method.fallback: other_render when within render API; non_render otherwise
method.textCategoryBoundary: All visible renderText ancestry outside RichTextLayout.init/inspect; includes post-layout issue handling, font-resource lookup and cleanup as well as SVG serialization
method.inliningPolicy: Use only visible ancestry; do not guess a missing frame from a sibling or program-counter offset

limitations: One approximately 1ms sampling trace of a repeating optimized release renderer; snapshots are not independent timing experiments.
Inlining, tail calls, symbol deduplication and unwind gaps can obscure phase boundaries. Unattributed descendants remain with their nearest visible category.
The text category is a renderText residual after layout/inspection exclusion, not a pure serialization stopwatch.
Diagnostic XML inspection excludes later diagnostic recording under renderText; that work remains in the text category.
Main-thread stack presence can include allocator, runtime, kernel or waiting work; these shares are not isolated CPU costs.
No attribution to exact milliseconds, historical regression delta, or attainable speedup is supported by this single profile.
Other threads, recursive-inclusive summaries and binary-image listings are excluded.
